g.title: j2274165242
g.text: Drifter. I am being hounded by the devil. He annoys me to no end with those little fiends of his ! All in the your name ! He says you simply wish to apologize on bent knee.

g.title: j1332469927
g.text: ฉันโดนปีศาจตามรังควาน รวมทั้งพวกปีศาจตัวเล็ก ๆ ด้วยที่คอยมาก่อกวนไม่หยุด ! ทั้งหมดนี่ก็เพราะคุณ ! เขาบอกว่าคุณอยากจะปรึกษาเรื่องให้ฉันช่วยคุณพา Monsieur Loid ขึ้นไปข้างบนงั้นเหรอ?

g.title: j2608411172
g.text: ฉันโดนปีศาจตามรังควาน รวมทั้งพวกปีศาจตัวเล็ก ๆ ด้วยที่คอยมาก่อกวนไม่หยุด ! ทั้งหมดนี่ก็เพราะคุณ ! เขาบอกว่าคุณอยากจะคุยเรื่องความยึดมั่นต่อ le Cardinal อีกครั้ง

g.title: j899244716
g.text: I am so very sorry. I know I offended you. And I didn't mean to. It was the very last thing I wanted to do, trust me.

g.title: j4177712951
g.text: Je vais le tuer ! Je savais que ce démon était rempli de la pire merde qui soit ! Je vais renvoyer ses conscrits d'où ils viennent par la peau des fesses !

g.title: j554978715
g.text: I will not linger for long, as he did much convincing already in your absence. And as the devil is wont to be, he made quite a good case for it.

g.title: j2005808530
g.text: I will not linger for long, as he did much convincing already in your absence. And as the devil is wont to be, he made quite a good case for it.

g.title: j3878582722
g.text: And I admit I am... growing quite weary of being trapped down here with sans recours.

g.title: j225832601
g.text: But it was not his words, yet his cleverness you should thank. He sat me down with Monsieur Loid.

g.title: j2756076455
g.text: [Confess feelings.] Because I care about you deeply, Marie. I adore you.

g.title: j466286532
g.text: Never mind. This was clearly a mistake.

g.title: j2299112081
g.text: So, I say, very well. I will assist you. You will have my help.

g.title: j4030474517
g.text: But Loid loves Albrecht. Doesn't he?

g.title: j399060093
g.text: I knew I was going to put my foot in my mouth. And lo and behold, I did.

g.title: j3062614312
g.text: You are as bad as he is.

g.title: j3526438694
g.text: It was Loid's clarity of sight that allowed me to see through my own clouded lens. For Loid loves le Cardinal - his Albrecht - yet he sees him for all his flaws all the same.

g.title: j2443881829
g.text: Yes. He does. And yet can see him for all his flaws all the same. And it was that clarity of sight that allowed me to see through my own clouded lens.

g.title: j4055844939
g.text: I am so sorry I resorted to Roathe to get your attention, but I didn't know who else to turn to.

g.title: j3671121223
g.text: For what does it mean to love another, but to accept them for all the best and worst that they are, après tout ?

g.title: j2372730330
g.text: Oh, Drifter... my poor Drifter. You did not have to go to such lengths to find my forgiveness.

g.title: j171044204
g.text: I would have given it to you had you but asked. You already have a place in my heart, you know ?

g.title: j1339251059
g.text: But I went through so much trouble...

g.title: j3850517521
g.text: Oui ! And if you wish to be together with me, than I would like this as well.

g.title: j378739374
g.text: And that is your own fault, not mine ! But if you wish to be together with me, than I would like this as well.

g.title: j4144528018
g.text: Ah ! You have made me so happy !

g.title: j488936631
g.text: Je vais te jeter directement dans le Néant.
